results.hypothesis: The feature fires on pluralized measurement units immediately following a numeral, especially metric distance or mass units like “meters” and “grams.”
positive_probes: The wire stretches 12 meters across the yard.
She measured 45 grams of powdered sugar.
They hiked 8 kilometers before sunset yesterday.
Add 300 milliliters of water to the flask.
The package weighs 25 kilograms with packaging.
distractor_probes: The wire stretches several meters across the yard.
She measured 45 gram samples for comparison.
They hiked 8 miles before sunset yesterday.

results.hypothesis: The feature detects quantity expressions where an approximate or ranged number is paired with a unit or informal currency amount, such as “around 200 bucks” or “20 to 25 meters.”
positive_probes: Roughly 300 bucks should cover dinner.
The trail stretches about 20 to 25 miles.
She paid nearly 40 euros for the ticket.
Expect around 8 to 10 hours of work.
The package weighs approximately 2 kilograms.
distractor_probes: She paid exactly 40 euros for the ticket.
The trail stretches across twenty scenic miles.
Roughly three hundred people attended dinner.

results.hypothesis: The feature activates on noun tokens that serve as units of measure after medium-sized numeric values in technical or geographic prose, particularly at the number–unit boundary.
positive_probes: The trench extends 240 km across the basin.
Average rainfall reached 175 mm in April.
Transmission peaked at 320 MHz during testing.
The plateau rises 480 m above sea level.
Sediment cores were taken at 260 cm depth.
distractor_probes: The trench extends across the basin for hundreds of kilometers.
Average rainfall reached extreme levels in April.
Transmission peaked during testing at the calibrated frequency.

results.hypothesis: The feature fires on explicit numeral + measurement-unit expressions, especially metric units written in full or abbreviated (e.g. meters, grams, kilograms, km, mm), with the activation centered on the unit token immediately after the number.

She bought 250 grams of fresh coffee beans.
The trail continues for 8 km along the ridge.
Add 5 mm to the panel width.
The package weighs exactly 3 kilograms today.
distractor_probes: The cable stretches across the courtyard for a while.
She bought fresh coffee beans by the bag.
The trail continues for several miles along the ridge.
